title: changesRequested
body: A Python code-review CLI, run as chreq. RAG retrieves codebase context and a LangGraph agent reviews the change. The model comes from config: Claude, Gemini or a local ~30B model, compared in evals.

title: Job queue from scratch
body: A job queue with a worker pool, built from first principles to learn Go concurrency.

title: Spotify MCP server
body: Open-source MCP server that exposes the Spotify Web API to AI agents like Claude Desktop and Cursor. OAuth 2.0 PKCE with automatic token refresh, connection-pooled clients and a pytest suite.

title: ndstats
body: A Go command-line tool that computes statistics over NDJSON streams.
